meta.name: flutter-best-practices
meta.description: Use when writing, reviewing, refactoring, or planning Flutter/Dart code — screens, features, project structure, state management, folders, widgets, cubits/blocs, repositories, services, or tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查 Flutter 代码，遵循最佳实践
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果编写 Flutter 代码时希望保持高质量
copy.tagline_en: Review Flutter code to follow best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Flutter code and want to maintain high quality

howto.what: 安装后，当你在编写、审查、重构或规划 Flutter/Dart 代码时，Claude 会按照一套最佳实践来指导你：包括架构分层、按功能组织文件、使用现代 Dart 语法和不可变状态模型等。它会提供具体的参考文件和工作清单。
howto.when: 当你提到 Flutter/Dart 代码相关任务时触发，比如编写新代码、审查拉取请求、重构现有代码或规划项目结构。

say.text: 帮我审查这段 Flutter 代码，检查架构和编码规范。
say.note: Claude 会按最佳实践逐条检查。

say.text: 我要添加一个新功能，帮我规划项目结构。
say.note: Claude 会提供特征目录和状态管理建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude follows a set of best practices for Flutter/Dart code: separating UI from data, organizing by feature, using modern Dart, immutable state, and providing reference files and checklists for writing, reviewing, refactoring, or planning code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention tasks related to Flutter/Dart code, such as writing new code, reviewing pull requests, refactoring existing code, or planning project structure.

say_en.text: Review this Flutter code for architecture and coding standards.
say_en.note: Claude checks against the best practices.

say_en.text: Plan the project structure for a new feature.
say_en.note: Claude provides folder structure and state management guidance.
